title: Failed Sign-in Uplift While a Recovery Reset Is Outstanding
content:
> Harborline Customer Accounts

The failed sign-in uplift of the late-reset goodwill follows the account's temporary sign-in lockouts that began after the same calendar date two months before today, as recorded on the account history: three or more add $5.00, one or two add $2.50, and none add nothing. The uplift is a fixed sum added to the late-reset goodwill figure.

| Lockouts that began after the same calendar date two months before today | Uplift |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | $5.00 |
| 1 or 2 | $2.50 |
| none | nothing |

With today 30 November (hypothetical), the count starts with lockouts that began on 1 October; a lockout that began on 30 September is not counted.
